# Part 15 · $33,000 to Say Yes

**Engineering** · [Watch the reel](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DdrDfAuxsx8/) · Published 24 Sep 2026

> How do you cut an LLM yes/no check from $33,000 to $160 per million?

A frontier LLM judge costs about $33,000 per million yes/no checks, and a sure yes looks exactly like a coin-toss yes to your if (yes).

![Whiteboard for Part 15](canvas.jpg)

## The three rules

1. Move yes/no checks off the frontier model.
2. Route on the probability, not on the word: above 0.95 ships, 0.6 to 0.95 goes to a person.
3. Give every question a "none of these" box.

## Stands on

[Part 13 · Your Agent's Errors Return 200](../13-errors-return-200/): the check costs about as much as the work; this part makes the yes/no check cheap.
